videos.t: Tony Swatton Builds - Ray Cirino Guest
videos.desc:
In this episode of Tony Swatton Builds, artist and welder Ray Cirino joins Hollywood Blacksmith and sword maker Tony Swatton in the workshop to create a custom Damascus pizza cutter.

From the first sketch to the final hammer strikes, watch two makers turn an idea into a seriously badass piece of functional art.

Subscribe for more forging, fabrication, and projects that probably didn’t need to be made out of Damascus—but absolutely should have been.

0:00 Collaborating on a Dragon-Inspired Project
2:17 Casting the Bronze Dragon Head
4:51 Forging the Damascus Steel Blade
8:18 Machining the Han

videos.t: Tony Swatton Builds: forming a pauldron on a Pullmax machine
videos.desc:
In this short, Tony uses his Pullmax machine to form a brass pauldron (shoulder armor) for a costume.  

The Pullmax is an electric reciprocating machine used for shaping, cutting, and forming sheet metal.  The lower die is stationary, and the upper die delivers thousands of strikes per minute.  

#thetonyswatton #metalart #pullmax #armor

videos.t: Tony Swatton Builds: carving and polishing a spiral grip
videos.desc:
In this short, Tony polishes a spiral grip for a Pirate Sword.  After making a thousand or more of these grips, he could make one with his eyes closed!

#thetonyswatton #medievalblacksmith #woodworking #pirates

videos.t: What Happens When Adam Savage Visits a Workshop?
videos.desc:
Adam Savage visits the workshop to explore master craftsmanship and the intricate details behind a beautiful handmade crown.

It has been a decade since Adam last stepped foot in this shop, and he returns to observe the specialized techniques used to create unique copper pieces. The conversation focuses on the importance of surface texture and the meticulous process required to fix and refine these materials during the fabrication stage.

Whether you are a fan of Adam Savage or simply appreciate high-end metalworking, this visit highlights the dedication required to produce quality work. Watch

videos.t: Tony Swatton Builds: spiralizing a hammer handle
videos.desc: When you’re a historic hammer aficionado, you look for ways to honor the tool.  In this short, Tony applies his Swatton Spiral to a piece of curly maple.  He sure makes it look easy! #thetonyswatton #woodworking #medievalblacksmith #wood #welding #diy #forgedfromiron #titanium #metalwork

videos.t: Tony Swatton Builds: fluting a Copper Mermaid Tiara
videos.desc: In this short, Tony uses a raising hammer to do fluting - also known as stake repousse- on a copper Mermaid tiara.  #thetonyswatton #medievalblacksmith #welding #artisticmetalwork #repousse #metalsmith #artisticblacksmith

videos.t: Tony Swatton Builds: hand texturing an armor piece
videos.desc:
In this short, Tony shows that sometimes the best machine is the artist’s own hand.  Using a ball stake and hammer, Tony adds texture and shape to this piece of shoulder armor.
#thetonyswatton #medievalblacksmith #armorer #blacksmithartist

videos.t: Tony Swatton Builds: annealing and pickling brass shoulder spaulders
videos.desc:
In this short, Tony uses a torch to anneal shoulder “spaulder” pieces to a dull, medium red glow, and then quenches the pieces in a pickling acid to remove the oxidation.  

#thetonyswatton #medievalblacksmith 
#blacksmith #armor #metalartist
